summary: Additional Action primitive (issue #181): a Battle action a player may take out of the normal back-and-forth alternation, without ceding priority to the opponent first. New MatchState.AdditionalActions (scoped or unscoped grants), NextAction's priority-retention now decided by ExecuteAbilityEffects' own tail (a by-reference before/after snapshot, so an unrelated action forfeits dangling grants rather than letting them linger), and a new additionalActionReaction PendingChoice (mirroring attackReaction) so a card like Effortless Counterattack can negate one before it resolves. Wired Again!, Two Hands, and Effortless Counterattack as Strategy Wave 2 (3 cards). Reframed Equip (Battle)'s bespoke spellFollowUp window as a genuine scoped grant -- same user-visible behavior when no Reaction is available, but now correctly interacts with Effortless Counterattack and Two Hands. Also wired Justice of the Crane's own deferred printed-Magistrate bonus (from #179/#180) now that the primitive it needed exists, via a new PrintedKeyword helper (printed-only, distinct from Keyword's printed-or-granted blend).
validation: dotnet build clean; full test suite 107/107 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck-format; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (13/13 AI, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration).
remaining: Legion of the Bat still needs its own 'after a move resolves' trigger (unrelated to this primitive). The Attack-deferral path carries the Additional Action flag correctly, but Shinden's own separate deferred-choice sub-flow does not -- a narrow, currently unrealized combo (Shinden's Timing is 'Open', not 'Battle', so it can never itself be taken as an additional action; documented as a known scope limit if a future card changes that).
